newsitem.title: FINLAND: Big in-house deal boosts Tamrock.
newsitem.headline: Big in-house deal boosts Tamrock.

text.p: Shares in Finnish engineering group Tamrock Oy (formerly Oy Tampella Ab) rose on Friday in heavy volume stemming mainly from a single deal matched in-house at brokerage Alfred Berg.
At 1230/0930 GMT, Tamrock traded up 0.20 markka at 14.70 after two million shares had been traded in-house at 15.00 markka each.
"This is probably in anticipation of their interim earnings report," one broker said of the deal.
Tamrock is due to report first-quarter earnings on May 6.
Tamrock chief executive Jouko Jaakkola said by telephone he did not know who the buyers or sellers were, but that the two million shares represented about 1.5 percent of Tamrock's 133 million shares.
